summary.text: Clear Jade Dripping Wind is one of four variations of Wu Yong's immortal battlefield killer move Four Clear Transforming Winds. Strong wind thins into green water-pearl drizzle that lands as clear jade water drops.

claims.text: After clear jade lightning fails, Wu Yong changes the battlefield again. Lightning vanishes, strong wind weakens, and beautiful green water pearls form a thin drizzle. Feng Jiu Ge warns that this is clear jade dripping wind. Water pearl-like wind that sprinkles on Fang Yuan is reflected by reverse flow protection seal, leaving him safe, while many drops still reach Feng Jiu Ge after others disappear against his defenses. Clear jade water drops splash on Feng Jiu Ge with clear sounds until his body seems a human shaped musical instrument and delightful melodies echo continuously, after which Wu Yong reveals himself and names another variation profound immortal sound. Four Clear Transforming Winds has four variations: clear wind blades, clear jade lightning, clear jade dripping wind, and profound immortal sound.

Whether clear wind blades, clear jade lightning, clear jade dripping wind, or profound immortal sound, the essence of those variation moves is wind path; the Wu clan ancestor who created the battlefield could imitate other paths with wind, touching sword, lightning, water, and sound path. When Feng Jiu Ge sings Separation Song, the battlefield answers with all four variations at once, including clear jade dripping wind, layered over him.
